checks.Simpson_paradox: Separate domains; candidate-vs-baseline N10 signs differ, candidate-vs-user signs agree.
checks.ecological_fallacy: Paired user ranks; average effects do not imply every user benefits.
checks.Berkson_selection: Repeated exploratory cohort of 512 per domain; not an independent confirmation set.
checks.collider_bias: All fixed users retained; hit decomposition is explicitly outcome-defined and descriptive.
checks.base_rate_neglect: Absolute N10 and counts reported with relative differences; H50 gain vs baseline is 2 users per domain.
checks.regression_to_mean: No best seed selected; prior exploratory selection and noise still limit conclusions.
checks.survivorship_bias: All 1024 expected records complete across all arms; no outcome filtering.
checks.look_elsewhere: All planned arms retained; unadjusted intervals; H50 does not replace primary N10.
checks.forking_paths: Fixed seed0 and protocol before decoding; stage diagnostic is post hoc, not a preregistered hypothesis test.
checks.causal_language: Transfer failure is observed before beam changes; does not identify GRAM defect or isolate score calibration as cause.
checks.reverse_causality: Targets used for outcome calculations only; saved protocol excluded target-based candidate insertion.

decision: Current candidate-weight branch is not supported as the preferred mechanism; retain dual anchor as provisional baseline.
